recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a man in a suburban backyard, captured with high-grain film texture. The subject is centered, flanked by domestic clutter like a lawnmower and a child's tricycle. The composition is topped by a large, tightly-spaced serif title in a vibrant orange-red.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between domestic objects (lawnmower left, tricycle right)
Contrast between the warm orange title and the cool green/blue tones of the yard
Heavy film grain unifying the photographic and typographic elements
coreInvariants: Tight, overlapping letter spacing in the display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, occupying the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's white t-shirt provides a bright central anchor point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large orange title, move down the subject's body, and then scan the peripheral yard objects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense background foliage and grass minimize open negative space, creating a 'lived-in' feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural greens and browns of the lawn and foliage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Denim blue and white t-shirt provide cool-toned contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red used for the primary title and the tricycle.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy saturation in the photo contrasted with high-saturation graphic text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight, high-contrast serif with vintage proportions.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking causing character collisions
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' and 'u' are tucked tightly under uppercase serifs
The 'F' and 'B' have prominent, sharp serifs

composition.scale: Large, spanning the width of the frame

composition.position: Top left, nested above the first letter of the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for impact paired with a sturdy slab serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Heavy film grain overlay across the entire canvas

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s/90s retro serif feel with rounded terminals.
Modern serif with vintage flair and high contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body shot of a man in a white t-shirt and blue jeans standing in a messy suburban backyard with a lawnmower and a red tricycle. Apply heavy 35mm film grain and a slightly warm, nostalgic color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large display text at the top in a bold, high-contrast serif font. Set the color to a vibrant orange-red and adjust tracking so the letters almost touch. Add a smaller white slab-serif subtitle above the main text on the left.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Are the letters in the main title touching or nearly touching?
Is the color of the main title a saturated orange-red?

adjustableVariables: Saturation level of the orange text
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the hat or equipment
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the grain doesn't look like digital noise.
Ensure the orange text is the most vibrant element in the frame.
Verify the subject is centered and grounded.
Confirm the typography uses a high-contrast serif.
recipe.reuseFormula: Suburban portrait + 35mm film grain + Bold high-contrast serif with negative tracking.
